questions.question_english:
40. Below are two statements, one labeled as
Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): During an El Niño event, monsoon
rainfall in India and South Asia is often below
normal or suppressed.
Reason (R): Warm water shifting eastward in
the Pacific Ocean disrupts global atmospheric
circulation cells, altering trade wind patterns.
In the context of the above statements, which
one of the following is correct?
options_english:
Both A and R are true and R is the correct
explanation of A.

Both A and R are true but R is not the
correct explanation of A.
A is true but R is false.
A is false but R is true.
questions.explanation_english: The correct option is (a) because both statements are true. During an El Niño event, monsoon rainfall in India and South Asia is frequently below normal or suppressed due to the eastward displacement of warm equatorial surface waters across the Pacific Ocean. This alteration disrupts the global atmospheric Walker circulation cells, weakens normal trade winds, and shifts tropical convection eastward, leading to deficient monsoon precipitation patterns over the Indian subcontinent.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। एल नीनो घटना के दौरान, भारत और दक्षिण एशिया में मानसून की बारिश अक्सर सामान्य से कम या दबाई हुई होती है। प्रशांत महासागर में गर्म समतलीय जल के पूर्व की ओर स्थानांतरित होने से वैश्विक वायुमंडलीय वॉकर परिसंचरण कोशिकाएँ बाधित होती हैं। यह सामान्य व्यापारिक वायु को कमजोर करता है और उष्णकटिबंधीय संवहन को पूर्व की ओर स्थानांतरित करता है, जिससे भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप पर चढ़ती हुई वायु की गति बाधित होती है और मानसून की वर्षा में कमी आती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: During an El Niño event, monsoon rainfall in India and South Asia is frequently below normal or suppressed.

options_english: A. Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (A). Both statements A and R are true, and R correctly explains A. Deserts are indeed predominantly found on the western margins of continents between 20° and 30° latitudes north and south. This is largely due to the influence of cold ocean currents that flow along these western coasts, which cool the lower atmosphere and inhibit vertical air movement and moisture condensation. This atmospheric stability prevents the formation of rain clouds, leading to hyper-arid conditions typical of these desert regions. Therefore, the presence of cold currents is directly linked to the geographical distribution of subtropical western margin deserts.
